description.value:
You draw upon your knowledge of the Tarrasque, growing a dense, iridescent carapace of supernaturally reflective shell. For the duration, you gain the following benefits:

- You gain a +3 circumstance bonus to AC.
- You gain resistance 15 to physical damage (bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing).
- You gain the Deflecting Shell reaction.

Deflecting Shell [reaction] Trigger: A ranged spell attack roll targets you, a line spell would pass through your space, or you would be targeted by a spell that requires a ranged attack roll; Frequency: once per round. Effect: Roll 1d6. On a 1–5, you are unaffected by the triggering effect. On a 6, you are unaffected and you can redirect the effect as though it originated from your space, choosing new targets or direction within the spell's original range.

Heightened (10th) The duration increases to 10 minutes. The physical resistance increases to 20. The Deflecting Shell reaction can be used twice per round.
